label: No precipitation forecast
description: No precipitation amount is forecast for this hour.

label: Light rain
description: If it falls steadily as rain for an hour, this is below the WMO moderate-rain range.

label: Moderate rain
description: 5 mm in one hour is about 5 liters per square meter; if it falls steadily as rain, it is in the WMO moderate-rain range.

label: Heavy rain
description: If it falls steadily as rain for an hour, this is in the WMO heavy-rain range.

label: Very intense rain
description: UV Scout uses this clearer wording for the highest WMO rain-rate band; the WMO guide notes its original term can be confusing.
